description: This file defines functions and classes related to subgraph rewriting in torch.fx, including pattern matching and replacement in computation graphs.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a pattern match in the graph, including the anchor node and a mapping of pattern nodes to graph nodes.

classes.name: ReplacedPatterns
classes.description: Data class capturing details of a subgraph that was replaced, including the anchor node, nodes map, and list of new nodes.

methods.name: None _replace_attributes(gm: GraphModule, replacement: torch.nn.Module)
methods.description: Copies attributes from a replacement module into the GraphModule, updating submodules and attributes in the graph.

methods.name: list[Match] replace_pattern( gm: GraphModule, pattern: Union[Callable, GraphModule], replacement: Union[Callable, GraphModule], )
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a pattern subgraph in a GraphModule with a specified replacement subgraph, returning list of matches.

methods.name: list[ReplacedPatterns] replace_pattern_with_filters( gm: GraphModule, pattern: Union[Callable, Graph, GraphModule], replacement: Union[Callable, Graph, GraphModule, None] = None, match_filters: Optional[ list[Callable[["InternalMatch", Graph, Graph], bool]] ] = None, ignore_literals: bool = False, replacement_callback: Optional[ Callable[["InternalMatch", Graph, Graph], Graph] ] = None, node_name_match: str = "", )
methods.description: Enhanced version of replace_pattern that accepts match filters and a callback for dynamic replacements.

methods.name: list[ReplacedPatterns] _replace_pattern( gm: GraphModule, pattern: Union[Callable, Graph, GraphModule], replacement: Union[Callable, Graph, GraphModule, None] = None, match_filters: Optional[ list[Callable[["InternalMatch", Graph, Graph], bool]] ] = None, ignore_literals: bool = False, replacement_callback: Optional[ Callable[["InternalMatch", Graph, Graph], Graph] ] = None, node_name_match: str = "", )
